description: Terminal delivery verification record emitted by the yoro-supply delivery_verify Pregel cell. Confirms goods arrived at the construction site + were inspected on receipt + match the PO. Carries weighbridge / count / QC results IPFS-pinned (G2) and both buyer+receiver witness signatures (G3 minLength 2, must differ from each other AND from any supplier-side witness in parent purchaseOrder). Feeds into tatekata's `materialAttestation` per construction phase. Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G2, G3, G5 (Charter Rider §2(g) re-verification on arrival), G6 (deterministic dispatch).

shipmentIds.description: All shipmentTracking.shipmentId values for the legs that comprise this delivery.

deliveredAt.description: Timestamp goods arrived at the receiving location.

receiptQcResultIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the receipt-time QC results (weighbridge / count / spec-compliance / damage assessment).

buyerReceiverWitnessSignatures.description: G3: at least 2 buyer-side witnesses. The two DIDs MUST differ from each other AND from any supplier-side witness in the parent purchaseOrder.witnessSignatures (independence).

charterRiderRescanAttested.description: Structural G5: at arrival, the receiver re-verifies Charter Rider §2(g) — physical inspection confirms no conflict-mineral / rare-earth deviation from supplierSelection.conflictMineralAuditCid.

deviationFromGanttHours.description: Signed delta from purchaseOrder.manufacturingScheduleIpfsCid Gantt (negative = early, positive = late). G6 determinism KPI.

deviationNotes.description: REQUIRED when qcStatus is any `accepted-with-deviation` or `rejected-*`. Free text; PII filter applies.
